title: Sequences and Progressions
summary: Recursive and explicit rules, arithmetic and geometric progressions, sums, and the Tower of Hanoi.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions

objectives: I can find and use the nth term of an AP and a GP.
I can find the sum of an AP.
I can describe sequences with recursive and explicit rules.
misconceptions: The nth term of an AP is a + nd.
Every sequence is either arithmetic or geometric.
